prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head turned about forty-five degrees to her left in a three-quarter view, her eyes still looking straight into the camera, one ear and the turned cheek clearly visible, and from this angle the full projection of her lips from her face is clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Late 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese poised refined beauty fair complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and natural skin tone, late 30s, a polished low bun with a few loose strands, pushed to the absolute extreme: ghost-white skin, the eye sockets shadowed in deep black-red hollows, deeply carved hollow cheeks, fully opaque wet-glossy blood-black lips with a hard sculpted edge, odd-eyed with two clearly different lenses: her left eye has a bright turquoise coloured contact lens with a radiating sunburst iris pattern, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, and her right eye has a glowing amber-gold coloured contact lens with a radiating sunburst iris pattern, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, the two eye colours both bright and clearly different from each other, gazing down from beneath lowered lids with the chin raised high as if looking down on a subject kneeling before her, lips sealed in a faint regal curve, an imperious, queenly, commanding expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): the absolute extreme of a 'wide mouth': a mouth so wide that its corners stretch out to the line below the outer corners of her eyes, spanning almost the full width of her lower face, the lips long, full and generously plump, a smooth, long, perfectly drawn horizontal mouth with a gently curved upper lip line, mirror-glossy deep rose with bright white highlights along both lips, every edge razor-crisp, perfectly symmetrical, so that the lips are by far the dominant feature of her face in this view, still reading as a beautiful, believable human face, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a very steep, sharply sculpted surgical nose: a knife-like bridge that rises steeply and sharply from the brow, a needle-pointed tip projecting well forward, and very narrow, tightly pinched nostril wings with thin, slit-like nostrils; her jawline and chin: a heart-shaped face: a wide forehead and high, full cheekbones narrowing in a smooth curve into a delicate, pointed, softly rounded chin like the tip of a heart. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about fifteen in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one straight bar across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; one small bar or ring through each eyebrow, all on the brow bone above the eyes and never on the eyelids; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit one thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Fine chains link the pieces: from the upper ear hoop on each side a delicate chain swags across the cheek to the ring around the nostril wing on the same side, passing well below the eye and clear of the lips, and one more fine chain hangs in a soft curve under the jaw from one ear to the other; the chains are thin enough that every piece and her whole face stay clearly visible. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of these two iron rings, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly nine separate massive weights, each of a different shape, all of them dark brown bronze with a rough cast, uneven surface and green-black patina, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal: on the left ear a round bell on a shortest chain, a barrel-shaped weight on a shortest chain, a square-sided cowbell on a short chain, a teardrop-shaped sinker on a medium chain, a pyramid-shaped lump on a medium chain, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a long chain, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a longer chain, a miniature anvil on a longer chain, a ship's anchor on a longest chain; on the right ear a teardrop-shaped sinker on a shortest chain, a cube-shaped block on a shortest chain, a barrel-shaped weight on a short chain, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a medium chain, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a medium chain, a round bell on a long chain, a square-sided cowbell on a longer chain, a ship's anchor on a longer chain, a hammer head on a longest chain. On each ear the two iron rings each carry their own column of weights, the two columns holding 5 and 4 weights, hanging side by side on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between two openings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real pastel-enamelled gold set with white pearls, pastel gemstones, hearts and stars, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished bronze, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: A plain seamless deep midnight-navy backdrop, nothing else in frame, no texture, no gradient. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
